reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune. Imported from CCEH tune 001062 (the melody read from 001062a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells Ernest O. Sellers as “Ernest O. Sellars”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. Ernest O. Sellers's dates (1869–1952) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Sellers_EO (Sellers, Ernest O. (Ernest Orlando), 1869-1952; CCEH spells him Sellars); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001062a.nwc).
